entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, finally! I need to return this helmet I bought. This is absolutely ridiculous, your hold times are a joke. I want my money back, now.
I certainly understand your frustration, and I'd be happy to look into this return for you. To get started, could I please have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. I don't see what the big problem is. I have the box unopened and it's just been sitting here. I expect a full refund.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered on September 21st. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What does it matter?! The color is not what I expected at all, it looks completely different than on your website. I'm not wearing a helmet that I hate. Now, are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager and start writing some very honest reviews about this experience?

That won't be necessary at all. I was just confirming the details for our records. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear and that your safety is never compromised because you dislike a product. I can absolutely process this for you right now.
Oh. You can? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened, it's a very straightforward process. I have initiated the return authorization in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file as we speak. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any shipping center.
And I'll get a full refund?
Correct. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay. Well... good. That's what I expected. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
